title_working: Nobody Noticed Her, Until The Votes Came In
world_rule: Not a rule world: a school class votes for the person they'd want beside them on a bad day.
logline: The girl nobody noticed wins the class vote, and the reason is a silence she once shared.

characters.name: Ellie
characters.want: to be left alone / to belong

characters.name: Theo
characters.role: the boy who tells the truth

characters.name: Classmates
characters.look: varied bright hoodies and hair styles, 5 distinct avatars

characters.name: Mia
characters.look: stu3: pink heart top, dark pigtails

characters.name: Sam
characters.look: stu4: blue striped shirt, short black hair

lines.text: Nobody noticed her, until the votes came in.
lines.say: (confident) Nobody noticed her, until the votes came in.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Close on a ballot box labelled VOTE; a hand drops a folded paper through the slot.

lines.text: The class voted for the person they'd want beside them on a bad day.
lines.say: (calm) The class voted for the person they'd want beside them on a bad day.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Classroom: the board reads CLASS VOTE; students write names on slips of paper.

lines.text: Everyone expected Maya, the class president, to win.
lines.say: (calm) Everyone expected Maya, the class president, to win.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Maya in a red blazer waves and smiles; classmates cheer her.

lines.text: Nobody even looked at Ellie, the girl in the oversized cardigan.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) Nobody even looked at Ellie, the girl in the oversized cardigan.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Ellie sits alone at the back, head down, sleeves over her hands.

lines.text: She ate lunch alone in the library, every single day.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) She ate lunch alone in the library, every single day.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Library: one long table, a single tray and an open book; Ellie eats alone.

lines.text: But she always noticed who else was alone.
lines.say: (calm)(soft tone) But she always noticed who else was alone.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: In the library doorway, Ellie glances up from her book at a boy sitting alone in the hallway.

lines.text: When the teacher read the result, the room went silent.
lines.say: (nervous) When the teacher read the result, the room went silent.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Mr. Reed at the front, holding a paper; every student frozen and staring.

lines.text: Ellie had won. By a lot.
lines.say: (surprised) Ellie had won. By a lot.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Ellie looks up, wide-eyed, then looks behind her to see who they mean.

lines.text: Someone laughed.
lines.say: (calm) Someone laughed.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Two students laugh, one with squeezed-shut eyes.

lines.text: This has to be a prank.
lines.say: (frustrated) This has to be a prank.
lines.speaker: Kid
lines.shot: A boy waves the idea away, scoffing.

lines.text: So the teacher recounted every vote. They were all real.
lines.say: (calm) So the teacher recounted every vote. They were all real.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Mr. Reed counts the slips one at a time on his desk; a tall stack grows beside Ellie's name.

lines.text: Maya stared at the paper, speechless.
lines.say: (surprised) Maya stared at the paper, speechless.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Maya, mouth open, the paper trembling in her hands.

lines.text: That... that can't be right.
lines.say: (nervous) That... that can't be right.
lines.speaker: Maya
lines.shot: Maya, paper shaking in her hands, shakes her head.

lines.text: Then Theo, a boy at the back, stood up.
lines.say: (nervous) Then Theo, a boy at the back, stood up.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Theo pushes his chair back and rises; every head turns.

lines.text: Last spring, I cried in the hallway after bad news. Everyone walked past.
lines.say: (sad)(soft tone) Last spring, I cried in the hallway after bad news. Everyone walked past.
lines.speaker: Theo
lines.shot: Flashback (cool tint): a hallway of lockers; Theo sits on the floor, head down, kids stream past.

lines.text: Ellie sat down next to me. She didn't say a word. She just stayed.
lines.say: (moved)(soft tone) Ellie sat down next to me. She didn't say a word. She just stayed.
lines.speaker: Theo
lines.shot: Flashback: Ellie sits beside Theo on the floor, shoulder to shoulder, silent.

lines.text: She waited with me when nobody came to pick me up.
lines.say: (moved)(soft tone) She waited with me when nobody came to pick me up.
lines.speaker: Mia
lines.shot: Mia (pigtails) stands, smiling at Ellie.

lines.text: She gave me her lunch when I forgot mine.
lines.say: (moved)(soft tone) She gave me her lunch when I forgot mine.
lines.speaker: Sam
lines.shot: Sam (blue stripes) stands, grinning.

lines.text: One by one, hands went up. Ellie had stayed for all of them.
lines.say: (moved) One by one, hands went up. Ellie had stayed for all of them.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Hand after hand rises across the room; Ellie turns, eyes filling with tears.

lines.text: Ellie never knew anyone was counting.
lines.say: (moved)(soft tone) Ellie never knew anyone was counting.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Ellie, tears in her eyes, smiles shyly; the class begins to clap.

lines.text: Kindness doesn't have to be loud to win.
lines.say: (confident)(soft tone) Kindness doesn't have to be loud to win.
lines.speaker: narrator
lines.shot: Final image: Ellie in warm light among her smiling classmates, Maya clapping too.

changes_from_previous: QA v1 (7.92) fixes: payoff made specific (Mia and Sam each say what Ellie did, then the hands); bridge line 'But she always noticed who else was alone' with a library-doorway glance; 'The class voted' (narrator is outside the class); line 8 mood tag calm; Maya gets a reaction line; Theo is named; shock volumes re-balanced (line 7 loudest).
